name: Michelangelo
hook: One sculptor, one ceiling, one signed Pietà: the Renaissance artist Jeopardy quizzes most.

facts.label: David
facts.statement: Michelangelo carved David between 1501 and 1504 from marble; the statue was placed beside the Palazzo Vecchio in Florence.

facts.label: the Pietà
facts.statement: The Pietà (1498-99) in St. Peter's Basilica is the only work Michelangelo signed, and its title is Italian for "compassion."

facts.label: the Sistine Chapel
facts.statement: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling for Pope Julius II; the Last Judgment went up on its west wall in 1541.

facts.label: Raphael
facts.statement: While Michelangelo worked on the Sistine Chapel, Raphael was upstairs in the Vatican painting The School of Athens.

facts.label: Carrara marble
facts.statement: Michelangelo's marble came from the Carrara quarry in Tuscany; the two Slaves he carved for Julius II's tomb are in the Louvre.

facts.label: Santa Croce
facts.statement: Michelangelo is buried in the Basilica of Santa Croce in Florence, where Machiavelli's tomb also stands.

facts.label: The Agony and the Ecstasy
facts.statement: Irving Stone's 1961 bestseller The Agony and the Ecstasy is about Michelangelo; a juvenile edition was titled The Great Adventure of Michelangelo.
